Debate Is Testing

avaswani@example.com
Abstract

We argue that comparative testing of case evidence already scrutinizes every assumption a critique claims to reveal. The result is a simpler model of judging that keeps policy debate open to everyone.

1 Introduction

Debaters often treat critiques as a gateway question that must be answered before any plan is weighed, therefore the round collapses into a contest of mindsets rather than outcomes. This paper shows that the gateway framing is a mistake 5.

Recurrent models factor computation along positions hth_{t} and the layer stack has N=6N=6 identical layers, so the cost of comparison grows with the size of the case.
